parameters.name: DefenseType
parameters.description: The type of the protection rule.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the protection rule that you want to modify.

> You can call the [DescribeDefenseRules](~~461426~~) operation to query the protection rule ID. You can create a protection rule by calling the [CreateDefenseRule](~~461421~~) operation.

parameters.name: RuleStatus
parameters.description:
The status that you want to set for the protection rule. Valid values: 
- **0**: disabled.  
- **1**: enabled.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection rule template.
